neighbours.label: clock times: the digits of an hour:minute time (and 'at' / 'a las' just before it), not numbers used as quantities
fire: The ceremony will begin at 11:15 in the main hall.
La reunión comienza a las 10:45 horas en la sala grande.
Our flight to Madrid departs at 12:30 on Tuesday.
The pharmacy will shut at 4 p.m. over the holidays.
El partido se jugará a las 11:30 horas del domingo.
Breakfast is served until 10:30 in the dining room.
The lecture is scheduled for 11 a.m. next Monday.
The last bus back to the village is at 10:15 every night.
quiet: The ceremony will involve 115 students in the main hall.
La reunión reunió a 45 personas en la sala grande.
Our flight to Madrid costs 230 euros per person.
The pharmacy will stock 4 new brands over the holidays.
El partido reunió a 1130 aficionados el domingo.
Breakfast costs 30 dollars in the dining room.
The lecture drew 11 visitors next door.
The last bus back to the village has 15 seats left.

notes: Card: peaks on digits in '1:30 horas', '11-ji', datetime.time(11, 38), 'at 3 p.m.', plus ages. Probes: 'at 11:30' 0.61, 'a las 10:30 horas' 0.77, 'at 3 p.m.' 0.38, '9 a.m.' 0.38, but 'at 7:45' 0.20, '18:30' 0.21, '44-year-old' 0.18; quantities (44 grams, 30 pounds, 745 litres) < 0.09.
